# Qala Labs

> Qala Labs is India's full-service AI growth agency — combining performance marketing, AI automation, and AI search visibility (GEO/AEO) to build brands that scale.

## Core Growth Services

- [Services Overview](https://qalalabs.com/services): Comprehensive growth architecture across paid ads, creative production, and AI systems.
- [Performance Marketing](https://qalalabs.com/services/performance): Full-funnel Meta, Google, and Amazon ad management engineered for high ROAS and scalable CAC.
- [AI Automation](https://qalalabs.com/services/ai-automation): Enterprise operational automation, custom agents, and automated lead capture workflows.
- [AI Search Visibility & GEO](https://qalalabs.com/ai-search-visibility): Optimizing brands for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini.
- [AI Creative Production](https://qalalabs.com/services/creative): Scroll-stopping UGC, viral ad angles, and AI-accelerated video production.
- [Web Development](https://qalalabs.com/services/web-dev): High-converting Headless and Shopify storefronts optimized for speed and conversion rate.
- [CRO & Retention](https://qalalabs.com/services/cro): Conversion rate optimization, checkout funnel engineering, and LTV expansion.
- [Analytics & Data](https://qalalabs.com/services/data): Server-side tracking (CAPI), multi-touch attribution, and profitability dashboards.

## Verified Case Studies

- [Trotr Spain Pivot](https://qalalabs.com/case-studies/Trotr-Meta-Lead-Generation): 28x ROAS and ₹14L revenue through high-converting Meta lead generation.
- [Nutrivend UK](https://qalalabs.com/case-studies/Meta-Lead-Generation-Ad-UK-Market): B2B international market validation and automated lead capture.
- [Gaffar India Rebrand](https://qalalabs.com/case-studies/gaffar-india-rebrand): Complete DTC marketplace positioning and identity re-engineering.
- [Kashmiri Sound Movement](https://qalalabs.com/case-studies/kashmiri-movement): Zero-ad-spend cultural organic movement generating 25k subscribers.
